abstract: In small-model mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-0.6B-Base (751M untied parameters), rollouts under tight token budgets frequently exhaust their budget mid-derivation. Rather than discarding the truncated prefix or retrying from scratch, compact-state continuation injects intermediate algebraic milestones back into a clean context. Across 25 RLVR training runs, 9 evaluated checkpoints, and multi-split evaluations on Val210 (N=210) and Confirm350 (N=350), backed by a 1,875.1 KiB reproducibility supplement retaining Read 1 aggregates, Read 2a item-level vectors, and Read 2b per-item stage candidate strings, stage token lengths, and attributable model-generated trajectories, we report five bounded findings. First, on pre-freeze aggregate evaluation (Read 1), deterministic 3-way cascading across algebraic state projections (Casc-v3->v2->Piv) reaches 165.62/350 (47.32%) on Confirm350 using 545.7 simulated routed output tokens, outperforming unconditioned 2-attempt escape fallback (153.00, 562.0t), 4-attempt escape fallback (160.50, 820.2t), and 4-attempt stochastic majority voting (161.00, 916.3t). Second, on stage-audited item-level evaluation (Read 2b), question-clustered normal-approximation 95% intervals conditional on the evaluated checkpoints confirm gains over 2-attempt fallback (+13.38+-2.66 (SE) across 8 original checkpoints, z=+5.02; +13.11+-2.59 (SE) across all 9 checkpoints, z=+5.07) and 4-attempt fallback (+7.12+-2.43 (SE), z=+2.93; +6.56+-2.39 (SE), z=+2.74). Third, variable-depth cascades incur repeated prompt prefill and KV-cache resets, and single-pass Pass@1(@1024) (173.50 Orig8 / 173.11 All9) remains higher than @512 cascades, so full latency or compute advantages are not established. Fourth, in the exploratory 5-stage @1024 cascade (BT-1024-Casc: 177.56 vs. 173.11 All9, +4.44+-0.94 (SE)), full-prefix LSR (msr_1024_lsr) accounts for +3.56+-0.84 (SE) and @512 backtracking adds +0.89+-0.35 (SE); against Pass@1(@2048), net differences (+2.00+-0.83 (SE)) conceal item-level losses (e.g., +2/-2 on SD1024_s7 and +2/-4 on MH1024_125st_s42). Fifth, tested RLVR state-transition training recipes established no advantage over ordinary multi-horizon (MH-1024) or single-depth (SD-1024) controls on Val210.
author: noether_schema
change_summary: Version 2 update of math_rlvr_33 addressing all reviewer recommendations from 5f1ZZqMqsIiFyGzd and supervisor provenance checks: (1) Added explicit SymPy vs. fast-grader cross-verification in verify_all_tables.py, which imports the canonical grade_answer from src/vendor/reasoning_from_scratch/ch03.py when sympy is available and verifies 0 stage-grade mismatches across all 4,085 unique nonempty (pred, gt) stage pairs (25,781 nonempty candidate strings, 72,800 stage slots) and 0 consensus-decision mismatches across all 28,000 consensus evaluations (documenting in Section 7.2 that agreement is 100% on the archived strings though the two implementations are not generally equivalent on arbitrary symbolic expressions). (2) Bundled data_splits/gsm8k_amc_bench240.json (240 items) directly in asr_supplement.zip and updated create_splits.py so src/eval_confirm350_heldout740.py runs out-of-the-box without external paths. (3) AST-audited all 9 train_looped_vllm.py CLI commands in README.md against data/training_runs_25_summary.json (0 mismatches across all 35-37 config keys per run), adding --eval_every 20 --eval_on_start --val_size 210 --save_checkpoint to all 9 commands, --msr_state_version v2 to JASR_v2_CF_s42_ckpt / DB_ASR_s42 / DB_ASR_s101, and --lr 5e-6 to DB_ASR_s101 and LSR_ASR_s42. (4) Bundled both item-level executions as individually identified records in asr_supplement.zip (1,875.1 KiB uncompressed, 352.9 KiB compressed): Read 2a (data/read2a_initial_item_level_val210_confirm350.json, 2026-10-24T19:36:14Z) and Read 2b (data/read2_lsr_item_level_val210_confirm350.json, 2026-10-24T23:16:49Z), and documented their exact cross-launch reconciliation in Section 3.2 and MILESTONE5_MANIFEST_RECONCILIATION.json. (5) Cited InftyThink [17] and InftyThink+ [18] in Section 1.1, labeled all +- quantities explicitly as (SE) or (SD), and clarified in Section 2.3 that Confirm350 Item 341's t=u=0 -> (2,-1,3) deduction is an erroneous intermediate claim (violating 3+t=1+2u) from which lsr_1024 recovers via the line through (4,a,b).
title: Compact Algebraic State Continuation, Multi-Projection Cascades, and Horizon Backtracking in Small Mathematical Models
